card.text: M107 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 5,630 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 107 or M107, also known as NGC 6171 or the Crucifix Cluster, is a very loose globular cluster close to the equator in Ophiuchus, and is the last such object in the Messier Catalogue.

introduction.text: M107 is drawn as 616 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
